title: Trimming a late session is for today only
items: When a session runs long, Trim session drops the last block you haven't started. It used to remove that block from your program too, so it was missing every week after.
Now the trim is for today only. The next time this day comes around, the block is back.

title: Short on time? Shorten today only
items: Adjust time on today's workout now opens. Tap 30 or 45, or step the minutes, and it lists what it would cut to fit. The red Start then runs that shorter version.
The cuts are for today only. Your program stays as written, so the next time this day comes around it is back in full.
Changed your mind? Tap adjust time again to close it, and Start runs the full day.

title: Sets you've logged stay as you logged them
items: Once a block is done, the bar at the bottom no longer shows a weight stepper or Swap. They still pointed at that block's first set, so a + meant for your next lift quietly changed a set you had already logged, and could count it as a PR.
When the whole workout is done, the bar shows just Rest and Finish. To change a set you've logged, tap its weight or reps on the set's own line.

title: Your rest counts down where you can see it
items: After you log a set, the Rest box at the bottom now counts down in red. It used to show the rest length and never move, so you had to time your own rest.
The rest after your first working set no longer stops itself two seconds in, so its end beep now plays.
Warm-up sets with no rest no longer beep the moment you log them, and their Rest box now says none.
Tapping Rest during a rest opens the timer without starting it over. Ticking a set's box starts that set's own rest instead of a flat 1:30.

title: A Start button on today's workout
items: Today's workout now has a red Start workout stamp on the card itself. The old Start was tucked inside the adjust time panel, which never opened, so the only way in was to tap the card.
The time under today's workout now matches its estimate. Some days showed a few minutes less than the Est. figure above it.

title: Finishing a block no longer ends your workout
items: In the one-block view, the red stamp used to say Finish as soon as one block was done. Tapping it saved the whole day, including sets you never did. Now it says Next and takes you to the next block with sets left.
Finish only appears once every set of the day is logged. To stop early, use Save & exit, which saves only the sets you logged.
If you used Finish mid-workout before this, check History for sets you didn't do and edit or delete that session.
